name: ARA1958
title: Release transfer cancelled
summary: A requested install or Hub update was cancelled before commit.
html:
A requested install or Hub update was cancelled before commit.

#Common causes

  • The user cancelled an active download.

#Fixes

  • Start Install again when ready. Cancelled partial downloads are removed.

  • Code: ARA1958

  • Constant: update::CANCELLED

  • Reported by: ara-update
